items.title: 23.8 Acyl Chlorides (–COCl group wale compounds) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 23.8, printed page 111 (PDF 114).

blocks.text: Acyl chlorides ka functional group –COCl hai. Saturated aliphatic acyl chlorides ka general formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₁COCl hai. IUPAC system mein inhein alkanoyl halides kaha jata hai. Maslan:

blocks.alt: Ethanoyl chloride, CH3-C(=O)-Cl, aur propanoyl chloride, CH3-CH2-C(=O)-Cl; O carbonyl carbon ke oopar.
blocks.caption: Ethanoyl chloride aur propanoyl chloride (kitab ke page 114 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Acid ke –OH ki jagah Cl aa jaye to acyl chloride banta hai: ethanoic acid se ethanoyl chloride (CH₃COCl) aur propanoic acid se propanoyl chloride (CH₃CH₂COCl). Naam mein acid ka '-oic acid' badal kar '-oyl chloride' ho jata hai.

Acyl chlorides carboxylic acids ke functional derivatives mein sab se zyada reactive hain, is liye inhein aam taur par is tarah banaya jata hai ke in se doosre functional derivatives (jaise esters aur amides) banaye ja saken.

blocks.prompt: CH₃CH₂COCl ka naam batayein, aur woh reagent bhi jo ise propanoic acid se banata hai.
blocks.explanation: Propanoyl chloride. Propanoic acid se ise SOCl₂ ya PCl₅ (ya PCl₃ ke saath garam kar ke) banate hain (23.5).

items: Acyl chlorides: functional group –COCl, formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₁COCl, IUPAC naam alkanoyl halides.
Sab se reactive acid derivatives; doosre derivatives banane mein kaam aate hain.
